questions.question: Before the last plague on Egypt, what did the LORD tell Moses Pharaoh would do with the Israelites afterward?
In Egypt, what did the LORD say He would do when He saw the lamb's blood on an Israelite house?
On the night of the first Passover in Egypt, where did the LORD tell the Israelites to put the lamb's blood?

answers.text: On the doorframes of their houses
On the horns of the altar
On the earlobes of the priests

questions.question: Why did the LORD tell Israel to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread?

answers.text: He brought them out of Egypt
He sent rain on their fields
He made them a great nation
